acceptance_criteria.description: Controlplane bootstrap applies relay EVENT callbacks immediately before EOSE completes.
EOSE marks historical sync complete but does not block rendering or event application.
Connection status exposes syncing while EOSE is pending and live after all connected bootstrap relays have sent EOSE.
Bootstrap fails closed when connected relay URLs cannot be determined for EOSE tracking.
Stale EOSE from a disconnected pre-reconnect syncing subscription cannot mark the current connection live.
